title: A partial AWQ loader prototype reduced sampled startup peak but remains unqualified
summary: Two completed loading pairs showed a 476 MiB lower sampled startup peak at roughly two seconds more loading time. This is partial evidence from a stopped prototype, not confirmation that the model fits a smaller GPU.
scope: 2080 Ti/WSL, 7B AWQ at 1,280 GPU KV blocks; five completed configurations and a separately interrupted continuation were retained. Serving-memory qualification is a different result.
limitations: Only two completed loader pairs, whole-device sampled peaks, no follow-on pressure or persistent qualification. The first loading prototype worsened startup memory. Historical source and reproduction inputs remain outside the active implementation.
decision: Preserve the partial positive and failed first approach without importing the prototype or treating it as an active task. Resumption requires a new explicit decision.
